summary: Iteration 14 (light-mode hero vignette fix) verified end-to-end. The dark radial vignette is fully hidden in LIGHT mode (getComputedStyle(.hero-vignette).display === 'none'), hero section bg reads as clean #fafafa (rgb(250,250,250)). DARK mode unchanged — .hero-vignette display === 'block', dark radial gradient visible, body bg rgb(5,5,5). Red intelligence node renders on canvas in both themes (r=255,g=32 pixel detected at ~(888,372) light and ~(1188,452) dark). Hero text colours in LIGHT are dark: headline rgb(10,10,10), subheadline rgb(82,82,82), overlines EST.EXPERIENCE/VENTURES LIVE/OUTCOME rgb(64,64,64). No console errors on either theme. Contact form empty-submit still shows sonner toast with rgb(255,255,255) bg + rgb(10,10,10) text. All 8 sections render. Screenshots confirm dark blob is GONE in light hero and dark hero looks identical to before.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: html.light .hero-vignette { display:none } cleanly disables the dark-mode vignette in light mode. html.light [data-testid=hero-section] { background:#fafafa } gives the hero its own light bg override so it doesn't fall through to the (transparent) default.
NetworkCanvas correctly reads themeRef for node/link colour softening in light mode without teardown — verified via active red-node pixel and animation working in both themes.
Iteration 13's cosmetic 'faint tracked labels' nit is now moot — hero overlines render at rgb(64,64,64) which is legible against #fafafa. No further action needed.
